correctness.rationale: Directly derive two involutive reflection maps from componentwise Sinkhorn scaling ratios at \(\omega=2\). Swapping terms of \(J=(UV+c(U+V)+1)/\sqrt{UV}\) under each reflection proves exact invariance. In logarithmic odds \(\mathcal H=2\cosh((X+Y)/2)+2c\cosh((X-Y)/2)\) has positive-definite Hessian and proper levels. The derivative bound \(|\phi_c'(y)|<1\) excludes other fixed points. Composition has Jacobian one, and area plus H preservation yields commuting Hamiltonian flow, hence rigid rotation on each compact regular oval. Finite rational checks of 125 initial cases plus 875 iterations independently reproduce algebraic identities; not used as proof of infinite statements.
